scenes.setting: Nighthawks bring 1-42 into Jason's house — the blood-stained silver armor worn by Leonard, who must bathe on a timer to bleed off the silver blade-lines that freeze the water solid; his parasite claims to recognize the blood: an ancient god from before the Cataclysm

Harvest Church: Emlyn caught praying like a true convert ('I don't want to betray the moon!'), then Lilith and how humans are made Sanguine; the Thousand-faced Hunter ingredients are found at 2,300 pounds — 265 more than Klein owns — and a second commission, to trace Jason Patrick Beria
Home to Minsk Street and into the bathroom with a thick stack of newspapers, as if settling in for a protracted war — Jason's handkerchief is going above the gray fog
scenes.text_anchor: as if he was about to fight a protracted war
